conventions.nestedRepositories: Projects with repository.nested=true keep their own Git history and are ignored by the workspace repository.

projects.name: Workspace core
projects.purpose: Shared instructions, skills, context tooling, documentation and launchers

projects.name: FinFolio app
projects.purpose: Self-hosted Indian portfolio tracker (myFinance repository) with AI insights and expense tracking

projects.name: FinFolio agent
projects.purpose: Proactive FinFolio portfolio alerts and local-model chat over Telegram

projects.name: Career agent
projects.purpose: Career opportunity scouting with approval-gated portfolio wiring; private workbench state stays outside the workspace

projects.name: Portfolio website
projects.purpose: Public portfolio site deployed to balaji-kumarasamy.netlify.app (React, Vite, React Flow); deployment is approval-gated

projects.name: Portfolio template
projects.purpose: Public MIT-licensed engineering portfolio template with fictional sample content, derived from the portfolio site

projects.name: Agenttrail dashboard
projects.purpose: Agenttrail Map for workspace ownership/file activity and Kitchen for available agent activity

projects.name: API services and RestAssured
projects.purpose: Spring Boot service, OpenAPI contracts, deployment assets, shared QA steps and RestAssured API tests

projects.name: Playwright Agent
projects.purpose: Playwright test authoring, acceptance assessment and behavioral mutation verification; evaluator lives in quality/

projects.name: Role-aware UI automation
projects.purpose: Role-aware demo app, mockserver and Playwright UI tests

projects.name: Playwright template
projects.purpose: Reusable Playwright page-object, fixtures and modular framework starter

projects.name: Workspace evidence
projects.purpose: Measures whether the workspace delivers what it claims, per project: context size, with/without-workspace agent trials and each project's own evidence

groups.name: 01 Products
groups.purpose: Runnable applications and agents, grouped by domain: finance, career, portfolio, agent-tools

groups.name: 02 Services
groups.purpose: Backend services with their contracts, deployment assets and API tests

groups.name: 03 QA frameworks
groups.purpose: Playwright Agent, role-aware UI automation and reusable test templates

groups.name: 04 Labs
groups.purpose: Experiments and integration labs that are not product code

groups.name: 05 Agent system
groups.purpose: Shared agent skills and the local model fallback setup

groups.name: 06 Evidence
groups.purpose: Workspace-level measurement: context, agent trials and imported project evidence

groups.name: 07 Knowledge
groups.purpose: Workspace documentation and passive upstream reference material

groups.name: 08 Tooling
groups.purpose: Shared scripts and their regression tests

groups.name: 09 Generated outputs
groups.purpose: Ignored reports, generated graphs, downloads and migration records
